scope: Aggregate original-plus-generated 1-4 reward entries for each proven boss/chest, shared across all item groups, variants and native enrichment paths.

deployment.pipeline: Normal PatchOrchestrator with source-identity guards, backups, assets, manifest and saved capacity clamp
deployment.launcher_note: Publication succeeded; a cp1252 encoding error affected only the helper final console print. The retained success result and actual output files were independently verified. No second forge was run.

preserved_native_exceptions.Name: [Mountaintops of the Giants - Evergaol - Roundtable Knight Vyke] Vyke's Dragonbolt

reward_budget.semantics: Every original or generated reward row contributes at most one lottery outcome. Original stacks count once; each generated armor piece, weapon and talisman has quantity one. Original bundles above four receive no generated additions.
